task:
UI redesign phase 2a — extract Explore view state from layout ownership, presentation UNCHANGED (plan: `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-02-v3-ui-redesign-plan.md`, on main, §4 row P2a "Extract Explore view state from layout ownership; retain query, filters, selection, result scroll and spatial context through layout changes" and "Phase 2 — map workspace (M09)"). This is the refactor that P2b (map window, Show on map, Expand) will build on; P2b and P2c need owner decisions (§7) and are NOT part of this PR — do not add a map window, Show on map, Expand, task tabs, docking, or any new control, and do not change what the user sees. apps/web only; no backend, route, API-request, renderer or scene-contract change.

START from current `main` (it contains the merged design kit #998, viewport streaming M08 #992, density M06 #999, nebulae M03, galaxy labels #991, filtered radius cap #994 and the Inspect tabs #1002). `apps/web/src/lib/features/explore/ExploreWorkspace.svelte` is ~2,500 lines and owns search, filters, ranking, selection, results, result scrolling, the galaxy camera/stream/viewport state, layers (density, nebulae, regions), hover and focus requests, all declared as component-local `$state`.

WHAT TO BUILD:
1. Add a view-state helper under `apps/web/src/lib/features/explore/` (proposed `explore-view-state.svelte.ts` using Svelte 5 runes in a class or factory, or a plain `.ts` store if runes are not needed — pick the simpler one that the existing tests can drive) that owns the Explore VIEW state that must survive a layout change: query text and submitted search, radius/scope, body filters, selected archetype and ranking profile, the selected system / last picked id64 / anchor, the saved-list and compare selections where they live in the workspace today, the result-list scroll position (captured on scroll, restored on remount), and the spatial context the plan names (retained camera, stream camera + detail mode, layer toggles such as showNebulae and selected/hovered region, focus target/revision). Query data (TanStack queries, `retainedResults`, catalogue packets) keeps its current ownership and immutability notes; move only what the plan calls view state, and keep `$state.raw` where it is today for large immutable payloads.
2. `ExploreWorkspace.svelte` reads and writes that helper instead of its own locals for the moved fields; its markup, classes, `data-*` hooks, aria, copy, request shapes and timing stay exactly as they are. `routes/explore/+page.svelte` and the test hosts (`ExploreWorkspaceTestHost.svelte`, `ExploreWorkloadTestHost.svelte`) keep working; the helper instance must be created ONCE per Explore route visit (one logical Galaxy context — never two instances, never a module-level singleton that leaks between tests or route visits) and may be passed to the workspace as a prop or via context.
3. Provide a bounded serialise/restore for the parts that already round-trip through the URL/sessionStorage today (keep existing URLs and storage keys readable; do not add new persisted keys without a test that proves the old values still load).
4. Make sure `SpatialCanvas.svelte` is still mounted exactly once, no duplicate subscriptions, effects, queries or listeners are introduced, and cleanup on destroy is unchanged (the M08 streaming requests and the density/nebula resource revisions must not double-fire — the workload tests should prove request counts are identical before and after).

TESTS ("Verify unchanged" row): extend `ExploreWorkspace.test.ts` and `ExploreWorkspace.workload.test.ts` to (a) assert the same DOM/requests as before — do not loosen any existing assertion; (b) add helper unit tests (`explore-view-state.test.ts`) for every moved field, scroll capture/restore and serialise/restore including rejection of out-of-range/invalid values; (c) add a remount test: mount the workspace with a helper instance, set query, filters, selection, scroll the result list, unmount and remount the workspace with the SAME helper instance, and assert query, filters, selection, scroll position and camera/layer context are retained while the search request count did not change (no re-search on remount — only an explicit search action changes the search). `MapLayers.test.ts` and the spatial component/lifecycle tests keep passing. Cypress `product-journey.cy.ts` / `spatial-foundation.cy.ts` need no new scenario for P2a; keep them green. Update the plan doc §4 row P2a status to "implemented in this PR" and add a CHANGES.md line under the unreleased section.

RULES: pnpm 11.25.0, `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`, then `pnpm check`, `pnpm lint`, `pnpm format:check`, `pnpm test`, `pnpm build` must all pass before you push; run `pnpm format` if the formatter complains. Component styles must satisfy `design-kit.test.ts` (tokens only; no literal colours or `var(--x, literal)` fallbacks). Do not touch `frontend/`, backend, sql/, workflows, deploy/ or scripts/. Do not create a flat `apps/web/src/lib/api.ts`. No new dependencies. Keep the F4 feature flag and its recovery path exactly as they are. In the PR body list the moved fields, what remained component-local and why, and paste the before/after request-count figures from the workload tests.
